exposure: Infraorbital nerve ligation (to induce trigeminal neuralgia)
cohort: The study involved 110 healthy adult male Sprague-Dawley (SD) rats, with some used for tissue collection and others assigned to experimental or control groups for trigeminal neuralgia modeling.
finding: The SK3 channel expression was found in trigeminal ganglions and decreased in trigeminal neuralgia (TN) rats, with its activation significantly improving pain thresholds, suggesting its pivotal role in TN pathogenesis and as a potential therapeutic target.
